assets.purpose: The Birthday Castle celebration illustration, showing Princess Zélie, Gigi, Beasley, Stella, and the Family Guests gathered around the birthday cake beneath seven Birthday Stars.

reuse.reason: ADR-0011 reuses the Phaser Edition's already-approved celebration illustration rather than paying to paint the ending twice. The bytes are copied unchanged, so the Godot Edition shows the celebration the family already knows.

selection.reason: Already approved for the released Phaser Edition and carried across byte for byte, so it needs no second approval pass.
